implementation_summary: Introduced an explicit runtime profile abstraction module (src/agent_governance/profile.py) with consumer as the only active profile. Profile.resolve_profile fail-closes on unsupported or ambiguous values; Profile.grants_source_maintenance always returns False so no profile default grants source-maintenance permissions. Threaded the resolved consumer profile through engine.main via a new optional profile parameter, and updated the thin launcher to resolve and pass the profile. The artifact builder bundles profile.py automatically via the existing _copy_tree_files runtime copy. Added focused deterministic tests mapping AC-T021-1 through AC-T021-3 to exact evidence with evidence types. No Markdown edits, no governance-core protocol semantics changes, no CLI command or footprint changes, no Skill activation surface changes, no source-maintainer profile implementation.

architecture.profile_module: src/agent_governance/profile.py defines ProfileError, ACTIVE_PROFILES={consumer}, DEFAULT_PROFILE=consumer, a frozen Profile dataclass with is_consumer/is_source_maintainer/grants_source_maintenance properties (all False for source-maintenance), and resolve_profile(name=None) that returns Profile('consumer') for None or 'consumer' and raises ProfileError for any unsupported or ambiguous value (empty, wrong case, whitespace, non-string, non-active).
architecture.engine_integration: src/agent_governance/engine.py imports Profile, ProfileError, resolve_profile from agent_governance.profile. main() accepts an optional profile: Profile | None parameter; if None, resolves the default consumer profile inside the try block. Validates isinstance(profile, Profile) and profile.grants_source_maintenance is False before command dispatch. ProfileError added to the except clause alongside GovernanceError and OSError.
architecture.launcher_plumbing: governance-skill/scripts/governance.py main() resolves the consumer profile via _engine.resolve_profile() and passes it to _engine.main(argv, package_paths=..., profile=profile). No new top-level functions added; launcher function set unchanged from T019 structural assertion.
architecture.artifact_compatibility: The artifact builder (_copy_tree_files of src/agent_governance/*.py into artifact runtime/agent_governance/) automatically bundles profile.py. No changes to artifact.py were needed. The T020 artifact isolation test proves the artifact bootstraps and runs all seven commands from the artifact-only environment with profile.py present.
architecture.zero_drift: The profile parameter has no behavioral effect for consumer. Consumer behavior is identical with the profile abstraction enabled: the same bootstrap, validate, state, event, skill, ecosystem, and archive code paths execute. Profile validation (isinstance + grants_source_maintenance) is defense-in-depth that never triggers for the consumer profile.
